title: Chocolate bar with unemphasised allergens

blocks.text: Ingredients: Sugar, Cocoa butter, Whole milk powder, Cocoa mass, Emulsifier (soya lecithin), Vanilla extract
Nutrition Information (per 100 g): Energy 545 kcal, Fat 31.0 g of which saturates 19.0 g, Carbohydrate 57.0 g of which sugars 55.0 g, Fibre 2.0 g, Protein 7.0 g, Salt 0.2 g
Made in the UK for Northgate Confectionery Ltd, 8 Foundry Road, Sheffield, S3 8AB, United Kingdom
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Not suitable for freezing.

notes: Milk and soya are present in the ingredients but printed in the same plain case as every other ingredient, so neither allergen is emphasised. Isolated single violation.
